subject: Volunteers needed for D-RUG through August

messages.author: 8c8f0ca54c4a2459
messages.subject: Volunteers needed for D-RUG through August
parts:
Hi all,

I'll be away most of August, so I'm looking for volunteers to run the D-RUG work sessions for 8, 15, and 22.  This is pretty much like holding office hours - you just need to be in the room and be ready to answer questions, or at least help people work through them.  I'll leave you some cash for cookies.

There will be no D-RUG this week, as our regular meeting space is being renovated.

Cheers,

Noam
